Older VK X versions had an older version of the downloader, which was very unstable on mobile internet and other low-speed connections.

In a result of network failure or old bugs - some of the cached tracks might be downloaded with a zero-byte file, which would not be played.

We recommend re-caching your tracks to ensure that they will play properly.
